entities.summary: Quit India Movement, a transformative movement in India (1920–1947). Emerged from Victoria and Crown Rule and Nationalist Movement. Catalyzed Gandhi's Salt March galvanizes the Indian independence movement and Mahatma Gandhi assassinated by Nathuram Godse.
